tools.name: search_lps
tools.description: Search Prilago's 3,520 direct institutional LPs (Private Foundations, Public & Corporate Pensions, University Endowments, Healthcare Systems, Insurers, Institutional Trusts, and Sovereign Funds) by name, institution type, geography, strategy, or retained investment consultant.

tools.name: get_lp_360_dossier
tools.description: Retrieve the complete Prilago Investor Profile for a specific Limited Partner: Total AUM, Target vs. Actual Private Equity / Credit / Real Assets room under target ($M), disclosed pacing plan, retained investment consultants, named investment-staff and governance contacts, filed Net IRR / TVPI / DPI

tools.name: match_fund_to_lps
tools.description: Find direct institutional LPs proven in primary filings to back early-series funds (Funds I to IV) from managers under $5B AUM in your strategy and check-size band, automatically removing any existing investors of a reference manager. Uses the exact same Early-Backers ranking engine as the Prilago w

tools.name: get_breaking_lp_signals
tools.description: Query Prilago's LP Filing & News Feed across SEC Form D XML filings, primary LP board/ACFR PDFs, and labeled trade-press items for disclosed fund commitments, pacing plans, RFPs, and CIO transitions.

tools.name: get_gp_peer_lookalikes
tools.description: Inspect any General Partner (Fund Manager) from verified LP disclosures: lists direct institutional LPs backing their funds, repeat re-up LPs, median disclosed check size, filed Net IRR / TVPI / DPI, and peer GPs.

tools.name: get_consultant_gatekeeper_clients
tools.description: Query Prilago's Investment Consultant & OCIO Graph to map which institutional LPs each consultant advises and their disclosed room under target allocation.
